deferred: certified packing numbers (heuristic k-center retained instead)
implemented: coarse occupancy, entropy/effective number, Good-Turing singleton diagnostic
frozen target-free rare-region discovery on input-order split calibration/holdout

metric_contract.frame_adjusted: centroid/area-normalized cyclic vertex alignment with best orientation-preserving 2D rotation
metric_contract.raw_ordered: centroid/area-normalized vertex coordinates, preserving cyclic start and orientation
metric_contract.scaling: pair and frame distances O(n^2 * side_count), occupancy/rare score O(n), saturation bounded by 32 replicates
metric_contract.stratification: population (law plus knob) and side_count; no pooling

provenance.source_dirty_contract: run only from a clean worktree for this owned path; a dirty source invalidates the artifact and must be repaired before reuse
provenance.source_revision_contract: analyzer_source_sha256 identifies the exact analyzer bytes; mutable VCS HEAD is intentionally omitted to avoid self-referential artifacts

interpretation_guardrails: raw/frame disagreement is representation sensitivity, not evidence that one view is correct
support coverage, mass concentration, finite-sample discovery, and feature variance are separate quantities
no p-values or population ranking are supported by this bounded descriptive sample

occupancy.cell_definition: producer combinatorial_cell/f_vector when supplied; otherwise side_count plus edge-length-CV bin floor(CV/0.1), capped at 4

rare_region_discovery.block_contract: contiguous input-order blocks; block counts are descriptive and independence is not assumed
rare_region_discovery.cost_contract: only cost_semantics=counts-v1 with attempt_count and accepted_count is consumed; attempts/accepted fields and attempt indices are ignored
rare_region_discovery.interpretation: scalar tail event only; it is not geometric support coverage or a population discovery probability
rare_region_discovery.split_contract: input order; first half calibration, second half holdout
